Academic Paper with Citations and Figures

Recent work by Smith et al. [2024] has shown that transformer-based models outperform previous approaches. This builds on earlier research (Jones, 2020) and Brown and Wilson [2018].

Several studies have confirmed these results [Lee, 2019][Park, 2021][Kim, 2023]. However, Wang [2022] found contradictory evidence in certain domains.

The methodology follows standard practices [ISO, 2019] with modifications for the specific domain [2024, Sec. 3.2]. Future work should address the limitations noted in Section 5. [2024]

References

  • Smith, J. et al. (2024). Transformer-based models for domain-specific tasks. JMLR.
  • Jones, A. (2020). Earlier approaches to sequence modeling. ACL.
